name: Consecutive-pair loop is off by one
modeled_on: A loop walks every index of a sequence with `for i in range(len(xs))` but the body reads `xs[i + 1]`, running past the end on the final iteration. This is the classic off-by-one that has bitten array-processing code in countless projects — the same shape as the bundled search demo.
ground_truth: Stop the loop one element earlier: iterate `range(len(xs) - 1)`.
